customer: I paid off my SUV loan months ago and the title STILL shows the bank as lienholder. I put a ton of miles on this thing commuting and I'm trying to sell it to you, but now this is holding everything up. What am I supposed to do here in Virginia?
agent: I understand how frustrating that is, especially when the loan is already paid off. If the title still lists the lender, the lien hasn't been released yet, so the first step is to ask your lender for a lien release letter. If you can't get one, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, though this can add 1 to 2 weeks. In the meantime, we can still make you an offer and book your appointment while you wait.
